jobs_results.title: Senior QA Tester - Ingeniero/a de pruebas de software IT · España...
jobs_results.description:
Estamos buscando un/a Ingeniero de pruebas de software altamente competente y experimentado para unirse a nuestro equipo. El candidato ideal será responsable de diseñar, desarrollar y ejecutar estrategias de prueba para garantizar la calidad de nuestros productos de software. Deberá tener experiencia tanto en pruebas manuales como en pruebas automatizadas, así como un profundo conocimiento de metodologías de prueba y herramientas de automatización.

Responsabilidades:
• Desarrollar y ejecutar casos de prueba manuales y automatizados para garantizar la calidad del software.
• Colaborar con el equipo de desarrollo para comprender los requisitos y diseñar estrategias de prueba efectivas.
• Escribir y mantener documentación de pruebas detallada, incluidos planes de prueba, matrices de rastreo de requisitos y reportes de defectos.
• Utilizar herramientas de automatización como Selenium, Cucumber y qTest para mejorar la eficiencia y la cobertura de las pruebas.
• Participar en la... implementación y mejora continua de procesos de prueba dentro del equipo.
• Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con otros miembros del equipo Agile para garantizar la entrega oportuna de productos de alta calidad.

Requisitos:
• 5+ años de experiencia en pruebas de software y aseguramiento de la calidad.
• Amplio conocimiento de metodologías de prueba y capacidad para escribir planes de prueba efectivos.
• Experiencia práctica en pruebas manuales y automatizadas, especialmente utilizando JavaScript/NodeJS para automatización.
• Experiencia con herramientas de automatización como Selenium, Cucumber, qTest, LambdaTest , etc.
• Experiencia en pruebas de productos SaaS .
• Competencia en Java y familiaridad con otros lenguajes de programación.
• Experiencia trabajando en equipos Agile integrados.
• Gran atención al detalle y habilidades analíticas excepcionales.
• Actitud proactiva y capacidad para aprender nuevas tecnologías rápidamente.

Beneficios:
• Oportunidad de trabajar en un entorno de desarrollo dinámico y colaborativo.
• Salario competitivo y paquete de beneficios.
• Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional y capacitación continua.
• Ambiente de trabajo flexible y posibilidad de trabajo remoto.

Compañía

Formar parte de THEWHITEAM es colaborar con una empresa formada por profesionales con una dilatada experiencia en consultoría tecnológica.

Creemos firmemente que las empresas y clientes marcan el camino a seguir en el sector, pero éste lo construyen las personas. Consideramos de vital importancia que nuestra organización se fundamente en nuestro mejor activo y marca de valor añadido que es nuestro equipo humano.

Beneficios

Por otra parte, te dejo también un pequeño resumen de políticas de la compañía para que nos vayas conociendo un poco mejor:

• Nuestro convenio es el de Consultoras y estudios de mercado

• Tenemos 23 días de vacaciones al año

• La empresa da como regalo el día de nuestro cumpleaños, para que podamos disfrutar de él sin trabajar

• Tenemos 14 pagas, 12 mensuales y dos extras (junio y diciembre)

• Como retribución flexible podemos pedir ticket guardería y también seguro médico + dental.

#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Real-time Senior QA Tester
jobs_results.description:
**Real-Time Senior QA Tester**:
En Sngular Studios buscamos un QA Tester Senior con experiência en el desarrollo de QA para Interactivos en tiempo real y Videojuegos
Ofrecemos:

- Contrato indefinido a jornada completa
- Posibilidad de teletrabajo
- Arranque de proyecto inmediato

Minimum requirements

Entre 3 y 5 años de experiência como QA Tester
Conocimiento de programas de trackeo y gestión de Issues, como Mantis
Gran entendimiento del proceso de desarrollo, equipos de trabajo, y workflows de trabajo
Conocimiento de las diferentes fases de desarrollo de un interactivo en tiempo real o videojuego
Pensamiento innovador y soluciones creativas
Capacidad analítica
Autonomía y capacidad de priorizar tareas
Un perfil personal muy enfocado al aprendizaje y de carácter curioso
Familiaridad con los métodos Kanban, Scrum y Agile

Desired requirements

Experiência liderando equipos de trabajo
Experiência realizando pruebas automáticas / pruebas unitarias
Conocimiento de herramientas de... gestión de proyecto / gestión de tareas
Buen nível de inglés
Conocimiento de los procesos de certificación en las consolas (Switch, PS4/5, Xbox...)
Experiência haciendo testing de Certificacion en juegos AA o AAA
Conocimiento técnico de publicación en iOS / Android

Duties

Trabajar mano a mano con los líderes de programación y diseño para construir una estructura que admita la creación rápida de prototipos y al mismo tiempo mantener la estabilidad del desarrollo a largo plazo.
Establecer flujos de trabajo de control de calidad y asegurarse de que la calidad de la información en la base de datos de issues sea lo más útil posible para el resto de los departamentos.
Coordinar los esfuerzos de prueba para ejecutar planes de prueba y realizar tareas de manera oportuna y precisa.
Analizar, validar e incorporar comentarios del equipo y pruebas de usuarios externos.
Coordinar al resto del equipo de QA
• *Benefits**:

- Contrato indefinido
- Posibilidad de trabajo en remoto
- Relativa flexibilidad de horario

DETAILS
• *Date**
- 01/30/2023
• *Contact address**
• *Contract**
- Permanent position
• *Salary**
- Unspecified salary

jobs_results.title: Lead QA | On site work
jobs_results.description:
We are a dynamic interdisciplinary team at Blackmouth Games an indie studio driven by a vision to redefine the landscape of next-generation online gaming.

At Blackmouth Games, we strive to innovate and create unique experiences that push the boundaries of what is possible in the gaming industry. To achieve this, we are currently seeking a full-time developer to join our talented team.

Are you in?

- Knowledge of "Testing and Optimizing" on Unreal:

---- Crash Reporting.

---- In-Game Analytics.

---- Automation System and all its modules/plugins.

---- Performance and profiling tools.

---- Replay system.

---- Visual Logger.

---- Software architecture.

---- Object-oriented programming methodologies.

---- Component-oriented programming methodologies (Game engines).

---- Video game QA development methodologies.

- Basic knowledge of C/C++ programming.

- Experience in integration of automatic processes and tools in CI/CD flows.

- Knowledge of the internal requirements of the... different distribution platforms.

- Experience working with GitLab or other version control systems.

- Fluent English skills, both written and oral.

Desired requirements

- High level of mathematics.

- Experience in physics engines (PhysX, Havok, ...)

- Experience in Unreal 5 development.

- Experience with any of the Microsoft and XBOX SDKs.

- Experience/knowledge on NFTs/Blockchain.

- Proficiency in driving production processes (pipelines and workflows) and utilizing tools such as Agile (Jira).

- Exceptional organizational skills, meticulous planning, and keen attention to detail. The ability to effectively structure and manage complex information.

- Strong communication skills that facilitate clear interactions across teams, disciplines, and various stakeholders.

- Residence in Madrid is preferred, although remote work options are available.

- Reside in Madrid.

Duties

- Design, implement and oversee test strategies and plans for video game projects in Unreal Engine.

- Collaborate with development teams to proactively identify and address quality issues.

- Develop and maintain detailed documentation of test cases, bug reports, and quality metrics.

- Actively participate in continuous improvement of the software development and quality process.

- Participate in the research and adoption of QA best practices for Unreal Engine projects.

- We make games with a strong craftsmanship component to which all team members actively contribute.

- Work-life balance is something we respect, protect and encourage through flexible hours.

- We do not feed the crunch culture.

- Possibility of continuous working hours and flexible start times.

- Constant improvement of our tools and processes so you can focus on creativity.

- Excellent working environment in the company of qualified professionals, who will help you make the most of your potential.

- Salary according to experience and skills.

====> Contact

https://careers.blackmouthgames.com/jobs/lead-qa-on-site-work
• All samples received will be considered confidential and in compliance with GDPR.

About this company We are an interdisciplinar team of developers, Blackmouth Games is an indie studio born to innovate and create a new approach to next generation online games.

jobs_results.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Your Job
• Review and test of requirements and specifications for the (further) development of our software products
• Definition and execution of test cases during the integration and system tests of our software products (applications, mobile apps and embedded camera software systems)
• Installation and maintenance of virtual environments to test our software with different operating systems and settings
• Installation and maintenance of special hardware and software test systems and test devices
• Installation, maintenance and usage of test automation software (e.g. Squish, Jenkins, Appium, Robot)
• Implementation of automated test cases using a test automation software or suitable script languages
• Test management by means of a special tool
• Analysis, recording and tracking of defects using a bug tracking tool

Your Profile
• Successfully accomplished studies in the field of computer science or equivalent education
• 2+ years' experience in an equal position or 5+ years... experience in a related field is a plus
• Very good English speaking and writing skills
• Skills in software engineering and test management
• Scripting skills with Bash, Python, JavaScript or other script languages
• Knowledge of Windows and MacOS operating systems on a scripting level
• Well-grounded network knowledge
• Skills in IT infrastructure and system integration tasks

jobs_results.title: QA Automation Tester
jobs_results.description:
Hello, we’re Toppan Digital Language. We’re a language solutions provider that’s enabled by tech. Our mission is to help global companies with high-risk, business-critical content sell with confidence in any language.

We aim to be the #1 localization partner for companies in life sciences and healthcare, market insights, consumer brands, financial and legal services. Our ambition is proudly backed by Toppan Inc., a worldwide leader in content distribution with a global team of more than 50,000 employees.

Operating globally, we design language solutions with the best teams and the best tech to meet our customers’ needs at speed, at scale—securely. We are obsessed with our clients’ success, and as importantly, our employees’. We want to build a reputable firm that attracts, develops, and retains exceptional talent in our industry. Our values reflect the thinking of our founders who have decades of trusted industry and localization expertise. They act as a major force in shaping our... company culture: an entrepreneurial spirit that embraces a growth mindset and an ethos of inspiring excellence. We want our teams and leaders to bring their best each day!

Reporting to the QA Lead, the QA Automation Tester will be a key player to ensure the successful delivery of quality software. This role will work closely with all stakeholders in the software delivery lifecycle to validate each release and enhance the manual and automated test coverage across the suite. The ideal candidate is used to dealing with a fast-paced environment and implementing test suites across both new and legacy software features. This is a great opportunity to work in a dynamic, creative and multicultural environment.
• Develop and execute automated test plans, test cases, and scripts to ensure high-quality software releases.
• Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including development, product management, and customer support to understand project requirements and ensure the successful delivery of quality software.
• Utilize automation frameworks (both front and backend) and tools to perform functional, regression, and performance testing.
• Analyze and report test results to ensure that the software meets or exceeds the defined quality standards.
• Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle and provide feedback on product design, requirements, and functionality.
• Continuously identify opportunities to improve testing processes, tools, and methodologies.
• Stay up to date with emerging trends and best practices in software testing and quality assurance.
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
• Strong experience in automation using tools such as Selenium, Appium, JMeter, or similar.
• Solid understanding of testing methodologies, software development lifecycles, and agile development practices.
• Experience with CI/CD/DevOps and sec ops will be highly regarded
• Ability to write SQL queries to validate data.
• Experience of having worked on a translation management suite of applications advantageous.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Excellent data accuracy and strong attention to detail.
• Excellent analytical and strong problem-solving skills.
• Highly organized and good time management skills.
• Ability to perform in a fast-paced environment, meet deadlines and use own initiative.
• Positive and creative mindset.
• Flexible and dedicated.
• Self-motivated and able to perform under minimal supervision.
• Demonstrated ability to multitask.
• Resourceful, quick learner and team player.

Toppan Digital Language is committed to equality in employment.

Reporting to the QA Lead, the QA Automation Tester will be a key player to ensure the successful delivery of quality software. This role will work closely with all stakeholders in the software delivery lifecycle to validate each release and enhance the manual and automated test coverage across the suite. The ideal candidate is used to dealing with a fast-paced environment and implementing test suites across both new and legacy software features. This is a great opportunity to work in a dynamic, creative and multicultural environment.
• Develop and execute automated test plans, test cases, and scripts to ensure high-quality software releases.
• Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including development, product management, and customer support to understand project requirements and ensure the successful delivery of quality software.
• Utilize automation frameworks (both front and backend) and tools to perform functional, regression, and performance testing.
• Analyze and report test results to ensure that the software meets or exceeds the defined quality standards.
• Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle and provide feedback on product design, requirements, and functionality.
• Continuously identify opportunities to improve testing processes, tools, and methodologies.
• Stay up to date with emerging trends and best practices in software testing and quality assurance.
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
• Strong experience in automation using tools such as Selenium, Appium, JMeter, or similar.
• Solid understanding of testing methodologies, software development lifecycles, and agile development practices.
• Experience with CI/CD/DevOps and sec ops will be highly regarded
• Ability to write SQL queries to validate data.
• Experience of having worked on a translation management suite of applications advantageous.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Excellent data accuracy and strong attention to detail.
• Excellent analytical and strong problem-solving skills.
• Highly organized and good time management skills.
• Ability to perform in a fast-paced environment, meet deadlines and use own initiative.
• Positive and creative mindset.
• Flexible and dedicated.
• Self-motivated and able to perform under minimal supervision.
• Demonstrated ability to multitask.
• Resourceful, quick learner and team player.

jobs_results.title: Salesforce QA Tester
jobs_results.description:
At Omega CRM we believe that the quality of the project we develop is very important. Therefore, we would like for our QA team to keep growing:

Duties & Responsibilities

As a member of the QA team that we currently have in Omega, the main responsibilities in your day to day may be the following:
• Creation of test cases based on the analysis of documentation or business requirements, defining the results precisely without entering into ambiguities.
• Execution of test cases based on their design with a degree of quality and efficiency.
• Reporting errors by attaching all information clearly so that the developer has no doubts when resolving them.
• Basic knowledge in software development.
• Generating a progress report of tasks or areas of responsibility.
• Mastery of the use of established QA tools for the project/service.
• Acquiring and consolidating functional knowledge of the assigned project.
• Reporting on results.
• Detecting and communicating risks and/or problems that... arise in tasks. Supporting individuals with less experience.
• Building automated scripts for basic, low-complexity test cases.
• Monitoring resolved incidents and defects to verify their correction

REQUIREMENTS:
• Minimun 2 years in a similar role.
• Knowledge of/experience with test management tools. Provar is a plus
• Knowledge in Salesforce Projects
• Good communication and teamwork skills
• Knowledge/experience in defect manager tool (Jira).
• English level B2 or higher
• ISTQB certification

WHAT DO WE OFFER
• Permanent contract.
• Flexible Schedule. We make it easy. Balance your professional and personal life.
• Certifications plan. Improve your skills and get the official certificate from our main partners.
• Home Office. You decide and we support you.
• Flexible retribution (public transport ticket, Ticket restaurtant, …).
• Health insurance.
• OMEGA in action. Our commitment to a better society is not just an intention
• Professional development: Evolve, grow and get where you want to go.

About us

We are a digital global company whose mission is to accelerate the business experience (BX) of its customers. In concrete terms, our 360 solutions allow business transformation and acceleration by means of technology and data applied to Customer #OmnichannelExperiences in fields such as #CustomerServices, #eCommerce, #Analytics or #Marketing. We target companies from different fields such as: #Retail, #LifeandSciences, #Manufacturing but also #Education, #NonProfit, #NGO etc. We are one of the top 3 partners of #Salesforce in Europe. Our team is composed of more than 500 people of 24 nationalities based in Spain and France, who have wide knowledge and experience that understands business processes and technology while enjoying what it does. Key to our success is the knowledge of our people. We are an innovation and Outstanding Knowledge award-winning, Salesforce Consulting Partner. Our priority is the well-being of the team. We foster a collaborative culture, involved and supported by our company values: #Talent, #flexibility, #commitment and #innovation. We bring them to everything we do. #TogetherWeGrow

jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres formar parte de una consultora multinacional especializada en el desarrollo software? En NTT DATA Centers trabajamos con las tecnologías más punteras del sector .

Los valores que nos identifican son la libertad responsable, energía creativa y la generosidad exigente; celebramos los éxitos compartidos y ponemos pasión en ser Ver el correo electrónico en click.appcast.io mejores en lo que hacemos.

Contamos con 9 centros , se encuentran tanto a nivel nacional como internacional y en 2014 nos unimos al grupo NTT DATA. Prestamos servicios en diversas áreas como Telecom, Banca, Sector Público, Salud, Seguros, Industria, Utilities y Energía. ¡ No hay sector que se nos resista !

Si quieres mirar los lunes con otros ojos, no dudes en formar parte de nuestro equipo de Quality donde solo tiene cabida el buen ambiente.

Nuestro objetivo es crear ambientes colaborativos, de manera que las personas logren lo mejor de sí al trabajar muy de la mano, compartiendo sabiduría y trabajando... hacia un objetivo común. Desde el primer día se te asignará un mentor/a, es decir una persona que te asesorará en tu desarrollo integral.

Evolución y crecimiento

Te ayudamos en tu desarrollo integral, lo que quiere decir que haremos que seas mejor profesional cada día, además de mejor persona, porque nuestros equipos destacan por su calidad humana, sus valores y principios. Ofrecemos diferentes alternativas de carrera para guiar tu desarrollo en función de tus intereses y motivaciones.

Necesitas registrarte para poder aplicar a nuestras ofertas.

Si te registras en nuestro portal podrás gestionar tu perfil, guardar nuevas ofertas y eventos, revisar tu candidatura y mucho más. Consulta aquí todas las ventajas de estar registrado.

▸ Si tienes cuenta, accede a través de tus datos de registro.

▸ ¿No tienes cuenta? Rellena el formulario para inscribirte en la oferta y automáticamente te crearemos un usuario.

Para completar el registro tendrás que seguir las instrucciones que te enviaremos por email.

Cargar archivos O suelte archivos

Consiento el tratamiento de mis datos para el envío de comunicaciones electrónicas del Grupo NTT DATA Europe and Latam.

Información Básica de Protección de Datos: Las empresas del Grupo NTT DATA Europe and Latam, como Responsables del Tratamiento, tratarán tus datos con las finalidades de: (i) crear y mantener tu cuenta como usuario del Portal de candidatos; (ii) remitirte comunicaciones electrónicas relacionadas con ofertas de empleo; en caso de que así lo consientas,(iii) remitirte comunicaciones electrónicas promocionales del Grupo; y (iv) posibilitar tu inscripción como candidato en el proceso de selección de personal al que aplicas y comunicarnos contigo en relación con el mismo. Tienes derecho a acceder, rectificar o suprimir los datos, así como otros derechos, como se explica en la Política de Privacidad del portal de Candidatos .En relación con la finalidad de posibilitar tu inscripción como candidato en el proceso, será de aplicación la Política de privacidad de candidatos . Asimismo, puedes consultar el listado actualizado de las empresas del Grupo en cualquiera de las dos políticas de privacidad.

Al registrarte aceptas el presente Aviso Legal y Términos de Uso del Portal de candidatos . #J-18808-Ljbffr
